title: SOUTHAMPTON THROWN OUT OF A FINAL, THEN GIVE THEIR COACH A DEAL TO 2029
description:
Out of a play-off final in May. A contract to 2029 in November.

On 20 November, Southampton gave head coach Tonda Eckert a new contract running to 2029.

In May, Southampton were removed from the Championship play-off final. This season they also lost four points, after admitting breaches of EFL rules.

Owner Dragan Solak has backed Eckert throughout. Loyalty, with a signature on it.

Middlesbrough lost that final 1-0 to Hull City at Wembley on 23 May. One goal, one very long afternoon. As for 2029: in football, that's practically a pension plan.

Smart loyalty or a step too far? Where do you land?
